content.comment_body: Good morning everyone. I would like to show weight readings on a large LED display. I need assistance with programming for reading and writing ASCII data. If possible, please share a ladder diagram to help with this task.
Can you specify the model of the LED display? Also, which communication protocol does the display use? Please provide the manufacturer and model details.
It is a 7-segment LED display. Communication is established via Ethernet, and the display uses SPI protocol.
As mentioned earlier: [product_name] only supports Ethernet TCP/IP with S7 or Modbus TCP/IP protocols. It cannot communicate with devices using the SPI protocol.

SPI refers to a serial peripheral interface, which is not used for LAN communication. Although your display module may rely on SPI, the LAN connector requires a different protocol. It will be difficult to provide help without more information, such as a link to the appropriate manual or more technical details.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are attempting to connect a [product_name] with a 7-segment LED display using Ethernet and SPI communication. Multiple respondents point out protocol incompatibilities, as [product_name] only supports Ethernet TCP/IP with S7 or Modbus TCP/IP—not SPI. The discussion shows a lack of clarity about the supported communication methods and highlights missing or unclear documentation about protocol compatibility, making it challenging to fulfill the user's goal.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] to interface with a 7-segment LED display using SPI protocol over Ethernet and is seeking guidance or example ladder logic for transmitting and receiving ASCII data.
